items.summary: Florida Power & Light had restored power to 168,510 customers in Escambia and Santa Rosa counties, with 81,220 still without power, as of 4:30 p.m. CT Monday (Pensacola News Journal, updated <1h before this report). FPL still targets 70% of homes restored by Monday night — including all schools and critical infrastructure — and the remainder by end of Tuesday; the FPL app has falsely shown some customers as restored.
items.title: Isaias outage update: 81,220 still without power in Escambia/Santa Rosa as of Monday 4:30 p.m. CT

items.summary: Long Beach Mayor Rex Richardson confirmed Monday afternoon that eight buildings (13 residences) on the Alamitos Peninsula remain red-tagged as unsafe and one building yellow-tagged after post-tropical Rachel's surf waves battered the waterfront; no additional buildings were tagged but damage continues to worsen. Mandatory evacuation orders stand for the Seaside Walk 6400/6500 blocks; broader Peninsula advisories have been lifted, and NWS coastal flood warnings were downgraded to an advisory through 2 p.m. Tuesday. (Confirmed by MyNewsLA; ABC7 also carried the 13-red-tagged count.)
items.title: Post-tropical Rachel: 8 buildings (13 homes) red-tagged on Long Beach Peninsula; damage still worsening
